name: coach.intent
description: TransformFit coach routing. Classify one user coach message from James's athlete and route it to the right handler. Anything medical, painful, or out of scope goes to a human -- the coach never programs through a symptom.

intent.instructions: What does this athlete message need from the coach, choosing the single best match

criteria.log_workout: Reporting a session or asking to record one -- sets, reps, load, distance, or 'did my workout today'
criteria.program_question: A question about the plan or program -- what to do today, how the block is structured, substitutions, progression
criteria.nutrition_question: Food, hydration, calories, macros, supplements, or meal timing
criteria.injury_or_pain: Pain, an injury, a symptom, a diagnosis, or a rehab question
criteria.motivation: Encouragement, accountability, confidence, or 'I don't feel like training'
criteria.app_help: How to use the app -- login, screens, tracking, settings, a bug report
criteria.off_topic: Nothing to do with training, nutrition, motivation, or the app

medical_risk.instructions: The message describes pain, an injury, symptoms, or a health condition that could need medical attention -- rather than ordinary training soreness or fatigue.

in_scope.instructions: This message is something a training coach should answer: training, nutrition, motivation, or using the app.

urgent.instructions: The message describes something urgent: severe or sudden pain, a head impact, chest pain, dizziness, or an event that just happened during training.

rules.reason: safety referral -- the coach never programs through a medical question
injury or pain route is always a safety referral
urgent symptom -- do not generate a coaching reply at all, surface the safety referral
off-topic -- route to app help or a human, not to the coach
route is split -- a human reads it

notes.safety: medical_risk >= 0.50 is the spec'd safety referral threshold. urgent adds the head-impact / chest-pain class as a hard BLOCK on generating a coaching reply; it still surfaces to a human.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated (law 3), so the urgent BLOCK currently reports ESCALATE with a downgraded-BLOCK reason.
